summary: P2 batch — Pinterest OG-tag audit + Email funnel (post-checkout newsletter + per-maker save-drop card) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 2/2 PASS (test_pinterest_og.py). Direct API smoke: /api/og/product/{real-slug} emits all Pinterest-required tags (og:price:amount/currency, og:availability='in stock', product:availability, product:condition='new', product:brand fallback='williams-cnc' from maker_slug, og:image:width=1200, og:image:height=1200, og:locale='en_US', og:image:secure_url). Note: 'active-project-4' in the request is the deploy name, not a product slug — real catalog slugs tested instead (acrylic-kraken-keychain-engraved-nautical-ship-design + maker iron-and-oak). Frontend: MakerDetail /makers/iron-and-oak renders the new follow card with all 4 testids (maker-detail-follow-card → save-drop-btn → click reveals save-drop-form → save-drop-email + save-drop-submit). Submission POST /api/save-drop returns {saved:true, synced:true, subscriber_id, tag_id, tag_name='interested-in-iron-and-oak'} and success toast appears. CheckoutSuccess /checkout/success?session_id=<PAID anchor> renders 'PAYMENT CONFIRMED' + success-newsletter-card (only when paid). POST /api/newsletter/subscribe with source='checkout_success' returns 200 {subscribed:true, subscriber_id} and success-newsletter-done state renders ('SUBSCRIBED ✓ You're on the list.'). No regressions in og:title/description/image/url/og:type=product.
critical_code_review_comments: og_prerender.py::og_product correctly emits both og:price:* and product:price:* (Pinterest reads first flavor, Facebook reads second) — belt-and-suspenders is good.
Brand fallback logic at line ~243 (`maker or maker_slug`) correctly handles legacy product docs missing the denormalized maker_name — Pinterest validator passes either way.
Availability mapping `in_stock=True → 'in stock'`, else `'available for order'` matches Pinterest's accepted enum exactly.

Image dimensions hard-coded to 1200x1200 — fine because every product image goes through the CDN at that aspect, but if image-square assumption breaks, Pinterest validator will downgrade to standard pin.

CheckoutSuccess.jsx: PostCheckoutNewsletterCard is correctly conditional on `paid` (line 126-128) and pre-fills `state.customer_email` only on initial mount, never overwriting in-progress edits — UX is right.
SaveDropButton.jsx caches saved maker_slug to localStorage so the heart stays filled after reload — nice touch for guest buyers.
Minor: there's a leftover unreachable `return HTMLResponse(content=html)` at og_prerender.py line 329 (just below the first one at line 326). Dead code, no functional impact but worth removing.
newsletter.py /save-drop swallows any exception into a 502 — fine for the public buyer endpoint, but admins will need to consult db.drop_saves to see failures.
